blind.description: A classical stone garden statue of a draped female figure holding a water jar or amphora against her hip/torso, mounted atop a square architectural stone pedestal. The stone surface has a realistic weathered, aged texture with greenish moss and patina detailing. The mesh is solid, continuous, fully textured, and rests flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: From directly above, the top of the figure's head with hair tied in a bun is visible alongside her curved shoulders and the rim and body of the tilted jug, all centered above the rectangular/square footprint of the pedestal.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly equal in height to the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 5 ft 6 in tall including the pedestal) and approximately 1.5 ft wide at the base.
